tiktok.opening: What happens when your AI finds bugs faster than you can fix them?
tiktok.payoff: Stop automating discovery until you have a triage system to handle the results.
tiktok.selection_reason: High-stakes, relatable problem that demands an immediate, concrete check.

overall_reasoning: The ProPublica report on Microsoft's 'mad dash' provides the most concrete, evidence-based lesson for solo operators: the danger of discovery outpacing remediation. This story was selected across all platforms because it directly challenges the assumption that 'more AI discovery' equals 'more productivity,' providing a clear, actionable lesson on the necessity of triage gates.
